name: Youth Allowance
summary: Fortnightly income support for young full-time students and apprentices.
who: 16 and 17 year olds only if they are independent or need to live away from home to study.
If you already get it, you can keep going after you turn 25 until your course or apprenticeship ends.
how: Claim online through Services Australia. The official page walks you through who can get it and how to claim.
catches: Under 22 you're usually treated as dependent, so your parents' income can reduce or stop your payment. You're independent from 22, or earlier if you meet a criterion such as supporting yourself through work or being unable to live at home.
Rates shown are maximum basic rates. They're indexed each 1 January.
Residence rules apply. Check them on the official page.

source.label: Services Australia: Youth Allowance for students and apprentices

key: Up to $482.40 a fortnight if you're 18 or over and live at home, or $677.20 if you live away from home (single, no children).
numbers: Applies if you're under 22 and not independent. Payment drops by 20 cents for each $1 of parental income over the free area.
